authors: Saberi M, Harati A, Tarnian F
title: Comparing dormancy breaking treatments in Parkinsonia aculeata seeds
why: Abstract (opened) lists 13 treatments on P. aculeata seed including GA3 at 100, 250 and 500 ppm and 0.2% KNO3, alone and with leaching, against a distilled-water control (15% germination), but reports only that treatments differed (p<0.01) and that leaching, scarification and hot water gave the highest germination. The per-treatment GA3 and KNO3 results are in the full text and would close sense_chemical (applied hormone and nitrate on living seed, owner reading 10(d)-(e)). The page lists no DOI.
queries: web: Parkinsonia aculeata germination gibberellin OR smoke OR nitrate OR dormancy
